item.tib: mkha' 'gro rtsa rgyud gsang chen rol pa zang thal mkha' 'gro rgyud 'bum gyi 'phrin las gsang ba mtha' thug
item.coloph: de ltar 'phrin las gsang ba mthar thugs 'di/ mkha' 'gro rgod lcam don 'bar ma mngon du sprul pa'i/ yum chen zla 'od zer ma de nyid kyis/ sprel lo sprel zla'i tshes bcu shar ba'i tshe/ o rgyan bde chen gling pa'i snyan du brgyud/ bdag nyid gsang rgyas gdam (bsdams) te dus yol tshe/ lo rgyal byi ba'i zla ba snron pa'i dus/ dad ldan grogs po'i rkyen kyis bskul ba'i ngor/ sprul pa'i gnas chen brgyad kyi ya rgyal gyi rigs bzhi'i nang tshan rin chen rigs kyi gnas/ bam brag brtsegs pa rin chen 'bar ba'i mthil/ bstan gnyis tshe dbang rgyal po'i gdan sa che/ mtsho steng bde ldan khrod kyi ri sul du/ dkar chag yi ge ris su bris pa 'di/ mkha' khyab 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal na bkra'i mtsho/ yang skem bstan pa'i bon 'di nyi shar nas/ mi nub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzug gyur cig/
